The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. We are seeking an Instrumentation Engineer for the Abqaiq plants operation departments (APOD) specifically the System Support Unit (SSU). The position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia and is a permanent full‑time expatriate family relocation package.

Job Overview

SSU is responsible for providing effective and proactive instrumentation, control, and safety system support to safeguard assets while adopting best industry practices and cutting‑edge technologies. Your primary role is to design, develop, and implement effective instrumentation solutions, assess current challenges, and deploy cost‑effective technologies to improve the reliability and efficiency of assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform periodical analytical studies of instrumentation system performance to overcome challenging operational programs.
  • Research and deploy emerging technologies related to instrumentation and control systems.
  • Act as an expert instrumentation and control systems resource for asset integrity management and risk assessment.
  • Develop Instrumentation and Control Plans (ICP) aligned with the organization's integrity performance objectives, assigning responsibilities, and timeframes for the responsible stakeholders.
  • Develop annual maintenance schedules for instrumentation systems in line with the ICP recommendations.
  • Review instrumentation system trends and initiate detailed engineering studies accordingly (e.g., increase in instrument failures, degradation of system performance, etc.).
  • Update the ICP based on the scheduled maintenance and modifications.
  • Ensure instrumentation system obsolescence are addressed by the relevant process owners and track recommendations.
  • Facilitate the investigation of instrumentation system failures and deploy lessons learned from the root cause analysis to the system to avoid reoccurrence.
  • Coordinate the updating of the instrumentation system risk register and ensure timely review upon occurrence of incidents in the industry or other similar facilities to reflect that in the risk register and identify applicable systems.
  • Perform periodical analytical studies of assessment findings to overcome challenging operational programs.
  • Evaluate the maintenance findings and perform periodical analytical studies of assessment findings to overcome challenging operational programs.
  • Provide consultation on specialized areas related to instrumentation and control systems.
  • Perform instrumentation system analysis studies to assess current challenges.
  • Review instrumentation system data and make recommendations/reports accordingly.
  • Apply instrumentation system maintenance programs to ensure the integrity and reliability of the plant assets.
  • Oversee instrumentation system modifications, such as calibration, repair, and replacement, to prevent or minimize system threats.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor's degree in Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field from a recognized and approved program; an advanced degree is preferred.
  • Have 15 years of experience in instrumentation engineering, including at least three years as a senior instrumentation engineer.
  • Possess a comprehensive knowledge of instrumentation principles, including measurement techniques, sensor technologies, and control systems.
  • Have sufficient background in instrumentation technologies such as DCS, PLC, and SCADA systems.

Experiência prévia desejada e/ou mandatória;

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

-Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Voice and Services Engineer
description:
1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As a Network Engineering member in the Voice and Services functional area, you will be responsible for proposing, analysing and defining the requirements for new and existing services and systems related to the voice systems under the responsibility of the functional area. You will prepare, design, test and provide new solutions or product changes of the already existing portfolio, define and support the technology evolution roadmap for the systems under the functional area, and participate and support the other functional areas in cross‑functional projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaboration with other Networks teams in defining and managing the projects for delivery of new solutions
  • Project delivery. Network design. Integration and migration strategy definition. Collaboration with other relevant departments. Responsible for end‑to‑end delivery
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Creation of technical documentation (HLDs, LLDs, WOs, etc.) and maintain it over the lifecycle of the solutions
  • Perform implementations in live environment. Understanding of end‑to‑end system testing requirements
  • Follow‑up and define quality and performance indicators
  • Capacity and performance analysis, reporting and improvement solution definition
  • Service & resource configuration definition and implementation on requested systems
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Elaborate, and manage the process for change requests to current partners in order to meet the network necessities
  • Control the network elements roadmap, being responsible for the necessary software/hardware upgrade during the components lifecycle
  • Generate and implement process improvements, including and especially cross‑team processes
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives

Requirements

  • Proven experience on implementation of live solutions on mobile telecom (GSM, UMTS, LTE, IMS), networks design, capacity management, engineering and architecture
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, GSMA, ITU standards and specifications
  • Experience in the design, test and operation of NGN based networks, including MSS/MGW, HLR/HSS, SBC
  • Experience in defining, establishing and maintaining voice interconnects, SIP/RTP based
  • Understanding about IMS architecture. Knowledge about VoIP, VoLTE, VoWiFi, and QoS
  • Experience with SMS service configuration and routing
  • IMS Architecture with understanding of IMS nodes including P/S/I‑CSCF, Application Servers
  • IMS Protocol Interfaces – Gm Interface, ISC interface, Sh Interface, Cx, SOAP/XML, etc
  • Experience in mobile services charging (offline, online). Knowledge and experience of OCS and, Ro, Ro+, Ga and Bp interfaces
  • Knowledge and experience with Diameter/SCTP networks and protocol
  • Knowledge and experience with Signaling Gateways and protocols including SS7, SIGTRAN, MAP and CAMEL
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape
  • English proficiency is mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • +3 years working on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks
  • Previous experience with Nokia, Oracle and Ribbon IMS products

Benefits

  • CLT contract – enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses – to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card – R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica – 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave – 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance – provided to mothers with children under 3 years old – R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities : Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure : Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team : From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly be exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment : Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development : Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience : Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture : Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude : Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer; we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Seniority level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment type

Full‑time

Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. To do this well, we must continuously raise the bar on software quality—without compromising developer velocity.

As a Senior QA Automation Engineer II , you won’t just be writing tests—you’ll be a force multiplier for quality across the engineering organization. You’ll work across multiple product teams to drive a strategic shift: from QA as a safety net to quality as a shared responsibility, embedded into every part of the development lifecycle.

You’ll lead efforts to identify critical coverage gaps, implement and scale test automation frameworks, and roll out self-service tools that enable developers to write, run, and promote tests with confidence. You’ll partner closely with embedded QAs, developers, and platform teams to shift QA towards an enablement model that amplifies impact across teams.

You’ll help pilot new ways of working that reduce manual effort, catch defects earlier, and improve the signal-to-noise ratio in our CI pipeline—whether through smarter automation, better tooling, or new AI-integrated approaches to test reliability and triage. Ultimately, your work will help Carta move faster without sacrificing confidence—by making automated quality an invisible but essential part of our software delivery process.

The Team You'll Work With

The QA Organization consists of ~15 QAs who work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Support teams. We work cross-functionally across the organization to make sure we are testing our product before our clients get to use them. This is a highly visible and critical role to help define and implement QA processes within different teams, plus help with manual and automation testing to test our products thoroughly and deliver with high quality.

About You

  • Fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills (we communicate closely with global teams on a daily basis!)
  • 6-8+ years of experience in software engineering or automation engineering role
  • Strong programming expertise in one OOP language like Python, Java, JS or Go (Python preferred)
  • Experience building and maintaining test frameworks using tools like Selenium/Webdriver, Pytest, Cypress, Playwright
  • Deep practical understanding of test strategies (unit, integration, E2E, performance, load testing).
  • Understanding of CI/CD and hands on experience with building and deployment tools (CircleCI, Jenkins, ArgoCD, Docker) and test analytics (e.g., Datadog, Sentry)
  • Strong experience with automation and software design patterns, with proven experience in both backend and frontend projects
  • Strong knowledge in cloud infrastructure and container orchestration (Kubernetes preferred)
  • You have the ability to understand the technical needs for the teams and help them implement QA processes and mindset
  • You are a self-starter who thrives on solving open-ended problems, not just executing Jira tickets
  • You identify pattern and recurring issues proactively and build scalable solutions to reduce future friction
  • You have a history of shipping test frameworks or systems used by others beyond your immediate team.
  • You have a track record of advancing quality maturity by shifting QA from hands‑on execution to developer enablement through self-service tooling and process improvements
  • You are passionate about mentoring junior level team members to help them grow and learn

Please submit your resume in English. This role will be hybrid in our Rio office.

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”). Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament. This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play‑off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027). The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections, and the escalation of risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the ongoing development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On‑going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast‑related overlay, as well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on‑site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio de Janeiro FIFA office. Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre‑planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play‑off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

Your Profile

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast‑paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project), collaboration tools, and planning software such as Autodesk BIM360 (preferred).
  • Proven knowledge of event planning and broadcast project management, with the ability to prioritise effectively and work independently.
  • Demonstrated track record of delivering excellent client service, with clear examples of supporting the needs of multiple business units.
  • Strong communication and high level of presentation skills, both written and verbal.
  • Evidence of adaptability, including experience acting as a facilitator and/or negotiator in complex or high‑pressured situations.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, with a proactive mindset and a strong commitment to high‑quality service delivery.
  • A collaborative team player who can perform under tight deadlines and shifting priorities.
  • Positive attitude, with patience and persistence when navigating challenges and resolving issues.
  • Experience working within a multicultural and/or multinational organisation.

We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. 1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1Global, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented. We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities. Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer‑centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and address design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFiExperience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Extended parental leave — 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

  • Gerenciar programas e processos oriundos ou relacionados ao Compliance – ex.: Programa de PLDFTP, Programa Anticorrupção e Antifraude, dentre outros.

  • MS Office avançado;

As a valued member of Oowlish, you will collaborate with premier clients from the United States and Europe, contributing to pioneering digital solutions. We are seeking a Senior DevOps Engineer with deep experience in AWS, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, and cloud architecture to lead the modernization, expansion, and operational excellence of our cloud ecosystem. In this role, you will design, implement, and manage highly scalable, secure, and reusable AWS infrastructure using AWS CDK, while also improving CI/CD pipelines, backup strategies, observability systems, and security frameworks across multiple accounts and environments.

This position requires strong hands‑on expertise and the ability to work at both strategic and execution levels. You will conduct infrastructure audits, design standard environments, create architectural roadmaps, and train internal team members to operate and maintain systems independently. You will collaborate with engineering, data, security, and business stakeholders to ensure reliable deployments, secure network access, effective monitoring, and end‑to‑end automation. If you are passionate about building world‑class cloud systems, mentoring teams, and delivering scalable DevOps practices, this role offers an opportunity to have a significant technical impact and leadership influence.

  • Design and implement reusable AWS CDK infrastructure

  • Document infrastructure and deliver training to internal teams
  • Build S3‑based storage and lifecycle rules for large datasets

Must‑Have

  • 5+ years of DevOps experience in AWS environments
  • Strong experience with AWS CDK (Python or C#)
  • Hands‑on experience with GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Experience with Aurora PostgreSQL, Redshift, SQL Server on EC2, EventBridge, IAM, API Gateway, Amplify, Step Functions, Glue
  • Experience with Chef, Ansible, or AWS Systems Manager
  • Familiarity with OpenSearch, Datadog, or ELK for logging

Nice to Have

  • Experience with event‑driven architectures
  • Experience with Docker‑based Lambda deployments
  • Knowledge of S3 lifecycle management & large data handling
  • Strong documentation & training delivery skills

Benefits & Perks

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). title: MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA E-MULTI - AP 4.0
description:
MÉDICO PSIQUIATRA E-MULTI - AP 4.0 – SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

A Estratégia Saúde da Família consiste em uma reorientação do modelo assistencial, realizada mediante a implantação de equipes multiprofissionais em Clínicas de Saúde da Família. Estas equipes ficam responsáveis pelo acompanhamento de um número definido de famílias de áreas geográficas delimitadas, atuando com ações de prevenção e promoção à saúde dessa comunidade.

As equipes da ESF são compostas por Médico Generalista ou Médico de Família e Comunidade, Enfermeiro, Auxiliar ou Técnico de Enfermagem e Agentes Comunitários de Saúde (ACS). Também há equipe de Saúde Bucal, composta por cirurgião‑dentista generalista ou especialista em saúde da família, auxiliar e/ou técnico em Saúde Bucal.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Promover ações de apoio matricial às equipes de saúde da família com o intuito de qualificar e ampliar o escopo das ações da atenção básica bem como qualificar a situação de saúde da população. Apoiar as equipes de saúde na família na realização do manejo das situações de saúde mental e risco psicossocial na atenção básica, propiciando, ainda, o acesso ao sistema de saúde e à reinserção social.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Medicina;
  • Especialização ou Residência em Psiquiatria com RQE;
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe;
  • Preencher os requisitos da Resolução SMS 4871 de 13 de Abril de 2021 , a saber:
  • RESOLVE: Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação na equipe multiprofissional do Núcleo de Apoio à Saúde da Família e Atenção Básica (NASF-AB) ao menos 2 (dois) dos critérios abaixo:
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação direta no saúde da família ou no núcleo de apoio à saúde da família.
    • Ter no mínimo 5 (cinco) anos de experiência profissional na área da saúde.
    • Ter no mínimo 3 (três) anos de experiência de atuação em um centro de atenção psicossocial (CAPS).
    • Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação stricto sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.
    • Certificado de conclusão de residência ou pós-graduação lato sensu em saúde.
    • Título de especialista reconhecido pela associação médica brasileira (AMB).
    • Ter participado de 3 (três) atividades de atualização científica e/ou acadêmica nas áreas: Saúde da Família, Medicina, Saúde Pública e Saúde Coletiva (congressos, seminários, workshop, capacitações em cursos presenciais ou à distância) nos últimos dois anos antes da contratação.

Local de Trabalho: AP 4.0 (Jacarepaguá e adjacências)

Requisitos e qualificações

Informações adicionais

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura. Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Esse papo também abordará a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e esclarecer dúvidas. Dicas: queremos saber sobre experiências alinhadas aos valores da PRIO, apresentando contextos, responsabilidades, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado. Em seguida, aspectos mais técnicos podem envolver um case ou entrevista com o gestor da vaga para conhecer os desafios técnicos e serem avaliados dentro dos requisitos. Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da área para a escolha final.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Atualize-se sobre notícias recentes da empresa, seja pela imprensa ou pelo site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO;
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre insucessos. Desejamos um bom processo seletivo. Venha fazer parte da PRIO.

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

The ideal candidate of the position will have a strong background in Offshore Oil & Gas Industry, be an expert in the field of Topsides Piping Engineering and provide strategic focus in the Topsides Concept Engineering for Conceptual/pre-FEED/FEED/EPC(I) projects being bid in the offshore area. This will include FPSO or FLNG facilities as well as other Fixed and Floating platforms/facilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage large-scale piping engineering projects: take charge of overseeing the planning, execution, and successful completion of large-scale piping engineering projects.
  • Develop project plans, schedules, and budgets in coordination with project stakeholders.
  • Allocate resources effectively, monitor project progress, and mitigate risks to ensure timely delivery and adherence to project objectives.
  • Answer general queries arising from clients, contractors or internal company departments on piping aspects of the system design.
  • Develop and review complex piping designs: utilize advanced engineering software and expertise to develop complex piping designs that meet project requirements and performance criteria.
  • Incorporate innovative solutions and best practices to optimize design efficiency, functionality, and safety.
  • Conduct thorough reviews of piping designs to identify potential issues, optimize performance, and ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and client specifications: ensure that all piping designs and engineering activities comply with relevant industry standards, codes, and regulations.
  • Prepare formal responses to comments from classification societies and clients on specifications and drawings.
  • Review project specifications and client requirements to ensure alignment with project deliverables.
  • Implement quality assurance processes to verify compliance and maintain documentation of all relevant standards and specifications.
  • Provide technical mentorship to the engineering team: serve as a technical mentor and subject matter expert for the engineering team, providing guidance, support, and knowledge sharing.
  • Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional development within the team.
  • Encourage collaboration and knowledge exchange to enhance the collective expertise of the engineering team.
  • Conduct technical reviews and approve documentation: conduct comprehensive technical reviews of piping designs, calculations, and documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance.
  • Provide feedback and recommendations to improve the quality and integrity of engineering deliverables.
  • Approve final documentation, including drawings, specifications, and reports, prior to submission to clients or regulatory authorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in piping engineering, with significant experience in offshore topsides design.
  • Extensive knowledge of industry standards, industry codes and practices related to offshore engineering and piping design – as well an understanding of scientific methods of problem‑solving.
  • Strong understanding of offshore industry terminology, concepts, and practices.
  • Proficiency in piping analysis and design software.
  • Proven track record of success in developing and performing Topsides Piping Conceptual / Feasibility Studies during pre-FEED/FEED or tender stage. Prior experience with FPSO or FLNG design development and/or engineering project delivery (e.g. at a top‑tier FPSO contractor) will be preferred.
  • Strong leadership and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, with strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work with and to communicate effectively with co‑workers, vendors, clients.
  • Fluency in English.

(2025) BR - R&I - Gerente de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva - L'Oréal Pesquisa & Inovação

A L'Oréal nasceu da ciência, criada pelas mãos e visão de um químico. Desde então, a ciência permaneceu no coração da nossa missão como empresa. O nosso principal objetivo é: inovar para promover o melhor da ciência e criar experiências de beleza inigualáveis para nossas marcas e consumidores. Nosso mindset é orientado para trabalhar com uma inovação aberta e colaborativa. Fazer parte dos nossos times de ciência e tecnologia significa constuir um mundo onde a humanidade e a natureza prosperam juntos. Então venha com a gente expandir os limites da Ciência e da Tecnologia.

Você é apaixonado pelos diferentes sentidos, e curioso pela ciência por trás de um produto e seu impacto nos sentidos e emoções humanas? Você é um líder inspirador, que tem a habilidade de liderar mudanças e desenvolver talentos na área de ciência sensorial e cognitiva? Se você se encaixa nesse perfil, esta é a posição que vai brilhar seus olhos e despertar suas sensações e emoções!

Estamos buscando uma liderança inovadora que tem visão de longo prazo e paixão por ciência sensorial para levar o time de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva (Evaluation Intelligence) a outro nível. A posição de Gerente de Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva na América Latina na L’Oréal é responsável por liderar um time inovador e orientado por resultados com forte conhecimento em análise sensorial, que contribui para todas as categorias em Latam (Hair care, Color e Skin care).

Essa posição vai liderar o time de forma estratégica, ajudando no desenvolvimento de produtos com visão holística de performance e experiência do consumidor pela caracterização sensorial e entendimento de comportamentos e emoções. Essa posição reportará diretamente para a Head de Evaluation Intelligence Latam e será parte do seu Mancom/time de liderança.

Principais Atividades

  • Liderar e implementar o Roadmap e Objetivos da Ciência Sensorial e Cognitiva para a organização
  • Liderar um grupo de analistas, técnicos e coordenadores (13+) e ser responsável pelo desenvolvimento do time em Ciência Sensorial & Cognitiva, Data, Digital & Tech
  • Liderar a compreensão sensorial aprofundada de nossos principais produtos, concorrentes e inovações atuais
  • Liderar com a equipe a comunicação dos principais e mais estratégicos resultados sensoriais/cognitivos de projetos para orientar a decisão de negócios
  • Construir uma organização efetiva e com recrutamento e retenção de pessoas chave para o time, promovendo o trabalho colaborativo e uma cultura diversa e inclusiva
  • Liderar esforços para promover diversidade e inclusão em todas as metodologias e estudos, garantindo que atendamos às necessidades de todos os consumidores em sua imensa diversidade
  • Ser responsável pela melhor avaliação sensorial & cognitiva da categoria, para responder a perguntas de desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecendo resultados que ajudarão a aprimorar conceitos, tecnologias e fórmulas
  • Permanecer atualizado sobre questões específicas da indústria e novas técnicas de avaliação sensorial/cognitiva e manter relacionamentos externos para identificar potenciais colaboradores para a exploração de novas metodologias
  • Implementar e desenvolver estratégias para atividades de publicação científica, transformação de aprendizados em melhores práticas internas e entrega desses aprendizados à rede global da L'Oréal
  • Ser pioneiro em novas tecnologias de aprimoramento sensorial para entender melhor o consumidor e a percepção/desempenho de produtos, utilizando ferramentas como realidade aumentada/virtual, ciência comportamental, IA e interação humano-computador, etc.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os parceiros da L'Oréal para construir relacionamentos de alta qualidade com as partes interessadas para garantir objetivos claros do projeto, alinhamento, crescimento e entrega de valor como uma equipe integrada
  • Liderar colaborações locais e globais dentro de Evaluation Intelligence, L'Oréal R&I Hubs e parceiros externos para desenvolver e implementar as melhores práticas de painel sensorial, novas formas de trabalho e metodologias sensoriais/cognitivas

Requisitos

  • Mestrado/PhD em Ciência de Alimentos, Engenharia, Química, Ciências Sociais, Psicologia ou áreas afins com mais de 10 anos de pesquisa sensorial/cognitiva, de consumo e de produtos em uma função estratégica

description:
Somos a Rede Hospital Casa um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO que seja organizado, prestativo e que tenha uma comunicação assertiva em seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Aplicar os conhecimentos técnicos de Segurança do Trabalho de modo a reduzir, neutralizar ou eliminar os riscos à segurança do trabalhador;
  • Orientar o sistema de segurança do trabalho, investigando riscos e causas de acidentes, fazendo as necessárias recomendações para evitar acidentes semelhantes, analisando esquemas de prevenção, observando dispositivos legais e institucionais que objetivem a eliminação, controle ou redução permanente dos riscos de acidentes do trabalho e a melhoria das condições do ambiente, para preservar a integridade física e mental dos trabalhadores;
  • Inspecionar locais, instalações e equipamentos da empresa e determinar fatores de riscos de acidentes;
  • Realizar auditorias internas e treinamentos de Segurança do Trabalho em todos os Setores da unidade Hospitalar, de forma rotineira, identificando condições insalubres e perigosas, tomando todas as providências necessárias para eliminar as situações de riscos, bem como orientar e conscientizar os colaboradores quanto a atitudes de segurança no trabalho;
  • Elaborar e implementar política de saúde, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente (SSMA);
  • Exigir o cumprimento das condições básicas de Segurança do Trabalho para empresas prestadoras de serviço e contratadas para execução de serviços nas dependências do estabelecimento hospitalar;
  • Acompanhar de forma permanente as atividades realizadas pela CIPA, estudando suas observações e propostas, visando a adoção das soluções corretivas e preventivas de acidentes do trabalho e meio ambiente dela valendo-se como agente multiplicador;
  • Controlar, distribuir e inspecionar os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI);
  • Elaborar documentos de segurança do trabalho como Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais, dentre outros;
  • Fazer inspeção em equipamentos de proteção contra incêndio, recursos audiovisuais e didáticos e outros materiais considerados indispensáveis, de acordo com a legislação vigente;
  • Propor normas e dispositivos de segurança, sugerindo eventuais modificações nos equipamentos e instalações e verificando sua observância, para prevenir acidentes;
  • Inspecionar os postos de combate a incêndios, examinando as mangueiras, hidrantes, extintores e equipamentos de proteção contra incêndios;
  • Comunicar os resultados de suas inspeções à coordenação do SESMT, elaborando relatórios;
  • Investigar acidentes ocorridos, examinando as condições da ocorrência, para identificar suas causas e propor as providências cabíveis;
  • Intermediar junto aos serviços médico e social da instituição, visando facilitar o atendimento necessário aos acidentados;
  • Registrar irregularidades e elaborar estatísticas de acidentes;
  • Promover campanhas, cursos, palestras e outras formas de treinamento com o objetivo de divulgar as normas de segurança e higiene do trabalho, bem como informar e conscientizar os trabalhadores sobre atividades insalubres, perigosas e penosas;
  • Dar suporte às perícias judiciais, à Medicina do trabalho conforme a deliberação da Coordenação do SESMT.

title: Senior Designer
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

Darkroom is looking for a Senior Designer who’s ready to roll up their sleeves and dive deep into brand, performance, and product design. We’re looking for more than just execution, we’re looking for perspective. You ask smart questions, push creative thinking, and know how to bring ideas to life in a way that’s both strategic and visually sharp.

This role is for someone confident leading creative projects across a range of deliverables, from landing pages and retention flows to paid ads and digital branding, while staying grounded in strategy and results.

You’ll work closely with Retention Managers, Developers, and Designers to deliver polished work that balances brand and performance. You’ll lead initiatives independently while collaborating often, and communicate directly with clients, presenting designs, leading workshops, and managing approvals.

You’ll report to our Director of Creative and work directly with fast-growing brands where the stakes and opportunities are high. This role is designed for someone ready to take on more ownership, broaden their skills across disciplines, and grow quickly within a team that values both creativity and clarity.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone.

What You’ll Do

  • Design digital assets that support a range of client marketing initiatives briefed by a Marketing Manager: paid ads, email & SMS, landing pages, organic social, Amazon creative, and more.

  • Create design systems based on a client’s brand guidelines to be used across multiple channels, ensuring consistency of a client’s brand identity, look, and feel.

  • Communicate with clients directly and present designs on calls, lead clients through workshopping, and obtain approvals while maintaining a strong working relationship.

  • Develop a deep understanding of what factors drive customers to convert on different marketing channels and execute designs within established best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with team members and clients for feedback and approvals to ensure your work adheres to a high standard of craft.

  • Design landing pages within Figma by using UI/UX best practices and adhering to Darkroom’s web design guidelines.

  • Collaborate with project managers and developers to deliver web design initiatives such as landing pages, web design updates, and more.

  • This role is on the Creative team and reports to the Design Director. You’ll work alongside a team of 8+ Designers, each supporting their own roster of 5+ client accounts.

Requirements

Hard Skills:

  • 3+ years of proven design work experience (agency or design studio experience is preferred)

  • Digital portfolio that demonstrates strong branding & identity, visual design, marketing design, and/or web design.

  • Proven understanding of design principles including layout, hierarchy, color theory, typography, and composition.

  • Strong ability to lead client calls, drive workshopping sessions, and manage a client relationship directly.

  • Strong proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite is required.

  • Fluency in English is required. Candidate must be proficient in speaking, writing, and presenting work to clients in English.

Soft Skills:

  • Highly creative individual who strives for detail-oriented design and can execute comfortably in a number of styles.

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Can effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and turn project requirements into compelling designs.

  • Self-motivated and proactive with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for detail-oriented deliverables.

  • Systematic thinker, who problem solves and time manages without heavy direction.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite

  • BFA or higher degree in Graphic Design or Fine Arts

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in-office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Additional information

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • -Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • -Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • -Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • -Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • -Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • -Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

KEY SKILLS

  • Attention to Detail.

About World Business Lenders

World Business Lenders (WBL) provides general purpose short-term real estate collateralized commercial loans to a broad customer base comprised of small and medium sized businesses throughout the United States that lack access to traditional funding.

This is a Contract/Consultant position. Generally, working hours will be 9:00am-6:00pm Eastern Time, Monday through Friday, although hours worked may be greater based upon operational requirements.

You must be comfortable working with productivity monitoring systems

The job requires excellent oral and written command of the English language.

RESUMES MUST BE SUBMITTED IN ENGLISH

Responsibilities

  • Assist in the Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, and Loan Servicing functions within the company
  • Support the development and implementation of comprehensive reporting suites across the organization
  • Contribute to the development of financial models and algorithms to analyze loan level and overall portfolio credit risk, identifying patterns, correlations, and sensitivities among portfolio variables
  • Assist in constructing pricing models for loan amortization schedules
  • Maintain the integrity of the loan records with the loan administration system
  • Prepare, analyze, and interpret monthly financial results
  • Monitor and support the management of mortgage and title policy for loan portfolios
  • Assist in identifying, analyzing, and documenting client portfolio risk and risk mitigating factors
  • Prepare loan monitoring reports on a regular schedule to review overall asset quality, including performance against original underwriting expectations
  • Generate monthly and quarterly financial reports, tracking actuals vs. budget/forecast for key metrics

  • Conduct periodic reviews and analyses of underwriting expectations post-funding: categorize exception distribution, rationale, and justifications; issue monthly executive-level exception reports to validate compliance with the underwriting policy and procedure
  • Support financial and functional due diligence requests for corporate transactions
  • Assist with other projects and duties as assigned by the Business Analytics Manager

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Accounting, Finance, Mathematics, Business Administration or a related field
  • 1-4 years progressive experience in financial analysis/modeling in the financial lending or mortgage industry
  • Solid knowledge of the principles of general business, accounting, quantitative analysis and finance
  • FP&A experience desirable
  • High degree of proficiency in Excel, including complex financial analysis/modeling, VBA/macros, relational databases and SQL.
  • Excellent English fluency, both written and verbal

description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next‑generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive‑level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e‑commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest‑growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Job description

Aqui no Edify temos o propósito que nascemos para construir novas formas de aprender e ensinar. Juntos, vamos repensar modelos de ensino e de aprendizado, co-criando soluções em inglês.

Para que você possa entender melhor, vamos falar como somos:

Main responsibilities

Desafio:

Como SDE do Squad de Plataforma você terá como desafio participar das definições de padrões de projetos, pesquisar e desenvolver boas práticas e otimizações para melhorar a performance dos SDEs e atuar na arquitetura das soluções junto aos Team Leaders dos demais squads.

O squad de Plataforma é essencial para manter a engenharia da Edify up-to-date e rodando com o balanço ideal de eficiência e qualidade técnica. Suas decisões irão afetar o futuro dos produtos Edify e o dia-a-dia dos colegas engenheiros em todos os nossos squads.

Atividades do dia-a-dia:

  • Colaborar nas decisões de arquitetura nas soluções juntamente com o team leader de cada squad e garantir a boa execução delas ao longo das sprints
  • Participar das dinâmicas e da rotina do squad
  • Implementar provas de conceito para provar / testar hipóteses de soluções
  • Realizar de forma proativa pair programming, fazer code reviews, revisar e sugerir melhores abordagens de implementação e decisões de arquitetura
  • Reproduzir e implementar bugfixes nos produtos da Edify. Participar ativamente nas decisões técnicas, contribuir com sugestões de solução e executar provas de conceito
  • Estar ciente e acompanhar as métricas de performance dos engenheiros

Requirements and skills

O que precisamos que você traga (skills obrigatórias):

  • Hard skills dev:
  • Experiência em arquitetar e construir aplicações cloud-native e altamente escaláveis na plataforma AWS com core services como: AWS (ECS, S3, RDS, Secrets, etc)
  • Node.js (Typescript, Nest.js, TypeORM / Prisma)
  • GraphQL
  • Testes automatizados
  • Logica de Pipelines e ciclo CI/CD
  • Conhecimento de techs de containerização e orquestração como Docker, k8s, etc
  • Técnicas de Observabilidade (e.g: log e trace distribuído)
  • Habilidade em entender requisitos de negócio e conduzir a implementação deles até o lançamento do produto / feature
  • Cultura de se colocar como accountable pela performance em produção.
  • Experiência em produção com serviços da cloud Amazon AWS

O que seria muito legal você ter (skills desejáveis):

  • Experiência com apps em produção com tech stacks variados
  • Pipelines de publicação para app stores (Apple e Google)
  • Conhecimento de infra-estrutura como código (IaC) usando Terraform
  • Proxy (Istio Envoy, NGINX)
